name: Google Drive
hint: A web OAuth client in your Google Cloud project with the Google Drive API enabled, and one account’s refresh token for this scope under https://www.googleapis.com/auth/: drive (drive.readonly if agents only read), for example from the OAuth 2.0 Playground; an External app left in Testing gets tokens that end after 7 days.

pick.name: list_files
pick.says: Searches My Drive and Shared with me; q filters, e.g. name contains 'budget' and trashed = false, as trashed files are listed otherwise, and shared drives need corpora=drive with driveId (or allDrives) plus supportsAllDrives and includeItemsFromAllDrives true. Drive returns only kind, id, name and mimeType unless fields names more, e.g. nextPageToken,files(id,name,mimeType,modifiedTime,owners(emailAddress),webViewLink).

pick.name: get_file
pick.says: Returns one file’s metadata, not its content: a default set of fields unless fields names more, e.g. id,name,mimeType,parents,owners(emailAddress),modifiedTime,size,webViewLink. Set supportsAllDrives to true for a file on a shared drive.

pick.name: export_file
pick.says: Returns a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file’s content as text, 10 MB at most. mimeType: text/markdown or text/plain for a Doc, text/csv for a Sheet (its first sheet only), text/plain for Slides.

pick.name: list_drives
pick.says: Lists the account’s shared drives, 10 at a time unless pageSize says more (100 at most); q filters, e.g. name contains 'finance'. A drive’s id is the driveId that searches inside it.

pick.name: list_comments
pick.says: Lists a file’s comments, 20 at a time unless pageSize says more (100 at most). fields is required, e.g. nextPageToken,comments(id,content,author(displayName),createdTime,resolved,replies(content,author(displayName))).

pick.name: list_permissions
pick.says: Lists who has access to a file, folder or shared drive. Drive returns only id, type, kind and role unless fields names more, e.g. nextPageToken,permissions(id,type,role,emailAddress,displayName,domain); set supportsAllDrives to true on a shared drive.

pick.name: list_revisions
pick.says: Lists a file’s versions; for often-edited Docs, Sheets and Slides the oldest may be missing. Drive returns only id, mimeType, kind and modifiedTime unless fields names more, e.g. nextPageToken,revisions(id,modifiedTime,lastModifyingUser(displayName,emailAddress)).

pick.name: get_about
pick.says: Returns the signed-in account and its Drive storage. fields is required, e.g. user(displayName,emailAddress),storageQuota.

pick.name: create_file
pick.says: Creates a folder, or another file with metadata and no content, in My Drive unless parents names one folder; set supportsAllDrives to true for a shared drive. Body: {"name", "mimeType": "application/vnd.google-apps.folder", "parents": [folder id], "description"}.

pick.name: update_file
pick.says: Changes a file’s metadata, and moves it with addParents (the new folder’s id) and removeParents (the old one’s). Body: only the fields to change, e.g. {"name", "description", "starred"}.

pick.name: share_file
pick.says: Shares a file, folder or shared drive. Body: {"type": "user", "role": "reader", "emailAddress"}, type being user, group, domain (with "domain") or anyone and role reader, commenter or writer; Drive emails users and groups unless sendNotificationEmail is false, which other types must leave out.

pick.name: create_comment
pick.says: Adds a comment to a file; Docs, Sheets and Slides show it under All Comments. fields is required, e.g. id,content,createdTime. Body: {"content"}.
